what: the corpus lane's list of the served rows of the unabridged BDB that are only the words opening a numbered sense of an entry, kept here byte for byte in the folder the lane keeps it in, with its rule and its receipt. The owner ruled how such a row prints (ruling 4 of relay v176, pinned in data/rulings/): as a note beside the readings, not as a pill. tools/apply-sense-openings-v1.mjs marks the rows
note: every sha256 here is the one the relay's letter names for the file, and the bytes taken hash to it. The lane's folder also holds a list of Classical Hebrew Words' name rows (chw-proper-names-v1.jsonl); the names gate reads the lane's later list of every source's name rows (data/names/), so that file is not kept here
